objective: Complete reionization abundance histories in a non-tilted axisymmetric Bianchi I universe and BBN-style species/ion abundance plots versus proper cosmic time and gas temperature

current_delivery.scope: Add/modify goal-driven DAG and machine-readable planning documents, then authorized publication by coordinator

shear.q_ref: s_*/H_FLRW(a_*); signed case parameter at locked reference epoch, not instantaneous Sigma
shear.Sigma: s/H; instantaneous normalized shear evaluated along each trajectory; distinct from q_ref
shear.q_amp: positive maximum amplitude selected in AX01/AX03; primary q_ref in {0,+q_amp/2,-q_amp/2,+q_amp,-q_amp}

physics_contract.gas_frame: Non-tilted unit normal n with n·n=-1 in x0=ct convention; physical four-velocity U=c n and U·U=-c^2; metric (-,+,+,+). Explicitly map each donor four-velocity/clock convention to this representation.

background_primary.fixed_inputs: same physical matter/radiation densities and Lambda for the physical family
background_primary.required_validity: Quantify and justify omitted radiation anisotropic-stress/geometry feedback over the selected trajectory; radiation quadrupole remains in RT

counterfactual.SAME_H: separate diagnostic with mean H held to its declared reference; never substitute for the primary physical-density-fixed family

physics_contract.matter: homogeneous non-equilibrium H/He, thermal evolution, energy/angular photons
physics_contract.radiation_baseline: isotropic proper-frame emissivity and isotropic initial radiation; both reflection-even in mu with symmetric microphysics
physics_contract.parity_scope: Axisymmetry alone does not imply vanishing dipole/force. Under the declared reflection-even baseline check J1 and net axial radiation force against the locked numerical tolerance; preserve non-tilted gas approximation
physics_contract.electron_census: ne=nH*(xHII+fHe*(xHeII+2*xHeIII)); nH and ne proper cm^-3, fHe=nHe/nH; no extra Q factor
physics_contract.fixed_time_thomson: tau_segment=c sigma_T integral ne(t) dt; cold comoving fixed cosmic-time segment is direction independent
physics_contract.observed_redshift: ray-defined observed-z endpoint surfaces may be directional; zbar=a^-1-1 is not observed redshift
not_mandatory: full tau or observational fit without a valid tail
forbidden_inference: retained synthetic endpoints imply physical EoR
empirical convergence implies rigorous continuum proof
physics_contract.provider_validation: Selected provider point and any root/interval path actually used have the same physical model/domain. No old FT03 certificate inheritance. A canonical independently validated point-implicit history plus empirical convergence is legitimate at its declared numerical scope; no new rigorous interval proof is mandatory.

donor_four_velocity_map.required_donor_binding: Record whether donor uses unit normal or physical four-velocity, coordinate/time units and the explicit conversion; do not silently interchange them.

primary_campaign.endpoint_reconciliation: If donor or source/provider support differs, AX01 makes and records a justified scientific endpoint choice. Never silently relabel a warm first step as full campaign.

scientific_completion_criteria.requirement: One justified, pinned background/donor/gas/radiation scenario with explicit epoch/clock/units and start/end decision; conflicting 20 K versus 6.137 K resolved as scientific choice, not permission request.

Implemented source-supported core rate/thermal provider covers full selected trajectory/energy domain with units/owners/provenance. Point and any root/interval path actually used share physical model/domain; no old FT03 certificate inheritance. Independently validated point-implicit plus empirical convergence is legitimate at labelled scope.

Primary axisymmetric physical-density-fixed signed-shear family and SAME_H diagnostic separately bound, with quantitative test-field/omitted-feedback validity estimate and reflection-parity assumptions.
Real proper-frame emissivity/time/initial-radiation binding, source history/support and units, proper/comoving conversions and single absorption/heat/work/boundary ownership.
Actual runnable Rust coupled driver and frozen argv/config/run limits consume AX01–AX04, with raw failures and resumable checkpoints; warm conditional CLI is not the full campaign.
Short zero-shear and nonzero-shear coupled pilots execute with positivity, nuclei/charge, photon/energy ledgers and relevant numerical controls.
Source-supported full selected FLRW interval, primary target zbar 20 to 4; any justified changed endpoints explicitly decided and labelled. A warm step alone cannot satisfy this criterion.

Matched zero and positive/negative shear histories cover the full selected interval with solved gas/ne/T and fixed matched source conventions; scientific null is allowed, not assumed. The minimum physical family is q_ref={0,+q_amp/2,-q_amp/2,+q_amp,-q_amp}; reuse the AX07 zero history rather than rerun it.

Explicit registry of baseline H I/H II/He I/He II/He III/electron plus every additional actually evolved nuclide/charge state. Neutral derivations, element charge fractions, complete selected-model baryon inventory (H/He baseline n_H+4*n_He), with any omitted reservoir explicit and tracked sum permitted below 1 and electron charge census validated; unimplemented D/T/He3/Li labelled optional missing extensions.

Canonical full-history abundance CSV records nuclear/ionic normalization, Y_i=n_i/nb and labelled electrons, with mandatory BBN-style abundance_vs_time and time-ordered parametric abundance_vs_Tgas plots, matched FLRW/BI comparison and signed delta-abundance diagnostics. Local hydrogen .1/.5/.9 milestone shifts use actual saved histories with explicit nonreached/censored status, independently of tau.
Baseline plus at least two refinement levels assess numerical/resolution error and response floor; rigorous interval/continuum support is labelled separately from empirical convergence.
At least one justified source and one IC robustness variant with assumptions/support fixed before each run; source/IC sensitivity is not posterior uncertainty.
Goal-specific manuscript workspace and reproducibility/source ledger reuse retained results only within their old scope, preserve raw outcomes and identify still-missing physical products.

Final full abundance-history data, BBN-style proper-time and gas-temperature figures, FLRW/BI comparison, convergence/robustness diagnostics and manuscript TeX/PDF reflect actual evolved products, not plan publication.

Independent scoped review decides applicable abundance-goal criteria and accepted conditional/scientific scope. No novelty/detection forced; resolved null/upper bound valid. NOT_RUN/blocked-paper only cannot complete the goal; unknown observer tail/full tau/full CMB are nonblocking secondary goals. AX15 decides C01-C16 and release-readiness; C17 remains PENDING_RELEASE until AX16 publication readback, so release is not a prerequisite of its own scientific review.
Reproduction instructions bind actual driver/source/config identities, complete artifact paths, raw run/checkpoint provenance and component-separated uncertainty.

Release publishes applicable reviewed scientific products at their admitted scope; independently verify completion evidence and distinguish publication from GOAL_DONE. AX16 closes this criterion after an accepted AX15 scientific decision and actual publication verification, then evaluates GOAL_DONE.

completion_rule.GOAL_DONE: Complete abundance history over full selected supported interval with all applicable 17 main criteria, correct normalization/conservation, mandatory time/Tgas species figures, robustness/numerical scope and independent AX15 decision. Declared scientifically accepted conditional scope is valid. Unknown full tau/tail or full CMB is not a completion prerequisite; publication, file presence or empty readiness never suffices.
completion_rule.accepted_result: Completed supported abundance histories and figures with quantitative resolved response, null or upper bound on the declared family are scientific results; detection and novelty are not forced.
stage_order: AX15: independently decide C01-C16, with C17=PENDING_RELEASE
AX16: publish reviewed products and verify remote/artifact evidence; close C17
Only then evaluate GOAL_DONE across all applicable criteria

controller.blocked_task: Create one concrete executable field-resolution, supply or repair task; continue independent ready work. No new generic review cycles.
controller.PAUSED_RESUMABLE: Context or tool allocation ends with durable state and exact next command; goal remains incomplete.
controller.BLOCKED_INPUT_OR_CAPABILITY: Name exact missing field or observed capability and local next action; do not declare done.
controller.new_segment_allocation: Coordinator may allocate the next bounded segment automatically within approved scope with cumulative accounting. Historical budgets/exceptions remain unchanged; do not reset an old cap or add an approval gate.

preparation_budget.scope: PREPARATION_ONLY; not a permanent prohibition on future bound scientific execution

required_species.state: charge-census ne; excluded from baryon inventory; nuclear Z not applicable

abundance_normalization_contract.additional_actually_evolved_species: Every additional evolved nuclide/charge state must be listed with A,Z,charge,element, provenance, state semantics and normalization; never omit it from outputs silently.

element_fraction.electron: not an element charge fraction; null element_fraction, report ye or xe separately

abundance_normalization_contract.baryon_inventory: n_b is the complete baryon inventory of the selected model, including any explicitly declared omitted reservoir; H/He-only baseline n_b=n_H+4*n_He. Electrons are excluded. The tracked sum is the full denominator only when the tracked nuclear registry is complete.
abundance_normalization_contract.BBN_number_abundance: Y_i=n_i/n_b; per baryon in the complete selected-model inventory, distinct from element charge fraction. Do not renormalize to a partial tracked registry.

electron_normalizations.must_label: always name denominator; electrons excluded from nb sum

abundance_normalization_contract.optional_mass_fraction: X_i=A_i*Y_i, separately labelled baryon mass fraction; never mix with number/charge fractions
abundance_normalization_contract.fixed_nuclear_vs_ionic: Donor BBN total elemental/nuclear abundances are fixed input inventory (proper densities expand); reionization evolves charge-state fractions. Do not claim nuclear reaction/BBN synthesis from ionic evolution.
abundance_normalization_contract.conservation: Require nonnegative densities/charge fractions and per-element charge fractions summing to 1. Sum over all model nuclear species A_i*Y_i=1 within the locked tolerance. If a declared baryon reservoir is omitted from the tracked species, tracked sum A_i*Y_i may be <1 and its missing fraction must be explicitly recorded. Check electron charge census separately; never clip invalid states.

omitted_baryon_reservoir.binding: Explicitly record whether selected-model inventory is exactly H/He baseline, all tracked nuclear species, or includes a quantified omitted reservoir. A tracked sum below 1 is legitimate only with that declared inventory.

temperature_plot_contract.time_axis: proper cosmic seconds with bound origin; if only elapsed time available label elapsed correctly
temperature_plot_contract.gas_temperature: Tgas may reheat/be nonmonotonic; plot parametric time-ordered trajectories with arrows/branch labels. Never sort by T to fabricate a single-valued Y(T).
temperature_plot_contract.optional_background_reference: Tref=T0/a with selected model T0, distinctly labelled reference; not exact direction-dependent CMB temperature in Bianchi I.
temperature_plot_contract.logarithmic_abundance_axis: Use where appropriate; exact zeros masked/annotated in display, never clip state or add a fabricated floor.
